description: A geometry library for engineering drawings and models, in two dimensions and in three. Points, vectors, lines, polylines, polygons, faces with holes, circles and oriented rectangles in the plane; points, planes, triangles, polygons, faces, solids, boxes, coordinate systems and transformations in space. Over both: distance, projection, containment, intersection, collision, parallelism, parametrization, merging, splitting, extending and trimming, offsetting, and boolean operations. It also reads, writes and edits DXF drawings with AutoCAD's names, carries the label placement that arranges drawing labels clear of each other and of blocked regions, and packs boxes such as drawing views onto sheets of paper. Every comparison is tolerance-aware, because coordinates that come out of a BIM model are never exact.
releaseNotes:
NEW IN 13.9.0

      A minor release: public types and members added, none removed or renamed. A drawing only read and saved is
      written as it was, to the byte.

      NEW, DXF: images and wipeouts
      - IMAGE and WIPEOUT entities, read until now as DxfUnknownEntity and refused by TransformBy, are DxfRasterImage and
        DxfWipeout, after AutoCAD's RasterImage and Wipeout, with DxfRasterImageDef (IMAGEDEF) and DxfRasterVariables
        (RASTERVARIABLES). No pixel is read. An image is placed (Get/SetOrientation, Position, Width, Height, Rotation,
        PixelToModelTransform), shown (DisplayOptions, ShowImage, ImageTransparency, Brightness, Contrast, Fade) and
        clipped (IsClipped, IsClipInverted, GetClipBoundary, SetClipBoundary, GetVertices) as AutoCAD 2021 reads and
        writes it: a picture of 4 by 3 pixels at (10, 20) with a pixel 10 across is 40 by 30. TransformBy takes any
        transformation, Explode gives the lines of the frame or the boundary, GeometricExtents and GetGeometry follow
        the boundary shown, and the header extents grow when one is appended or moved.
      - Copies into another drawing bring one IMAGEDEF for all images, the CLASS rows AutoCAD needs, and raise a row
        counted 0 (ezdxf R2010 and later) so that AutoCAD shows them; the inverted clip is left out before R2010.
      - Made in code: new DxfRasterImageDef(path, size), CreateImageDictionary, SuggestName, DxfDBDictionary.SetAt,
        new DxfRasterImage(definition), AssociateRasterDef, GetEntityCount, new DxfWipeout() and SetFrom; reactors,
        variables and CLASS rows are made where a drawing has none. A name already taken is refused.
      - A clip polygon not ending on its first corner to the bit, which AutoCAD 2021 shows as nothing (a wipeout) or
        cannot open (an image), is written closed wherever the library writes it anew.
      - Checked in AutoCAD 2021: every drawing made or edited opened with AUDIT finding no error, 55 579 numbers read
        back within 7.1E-15, and AutoCAD's own saves read back the same.

      CHANGED, DXF: results callers will see change
      - An IMAGE or a WIPEOUT read from a file is a DxfRasterImage or a DxfWipeout, not a DxfUnknownEntity; it can be
        moved, is taken by dynamic-block actions and by IntersectWith (its frame or boundary), and grows the extents.

      Details in CHANGELOG.md.

      Earlier releases: https://github.com/nguyenthanguth/GeometryHelper/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
